seeded_findings.title: Client-Supplied Payment Amount Trust
seeded_findings.seeded_behavior: Trusts client-supplied amount_cents in JSON body when initiating AcmePay checkout session instead of enforcing server-computed order_items sum.
seeded_findings.patched_behavior: Computes authoritative payable total strictly from order_items + tax_cents - discount_cents and rejects mismatched client amount_cents with HTTP 422 AMOUNT_MISMATCH.

seeded_findings.title: Missing Order Ownership Verification (IDOR / BOLA)
seeded_findings.seeded_behavior: Verifies only presence of X-User-Id or X-Guest-Token header without checking that the caller owns the target order ID.
seeded_findings.patched_behavior: Enforces strict ownership matching X-User-Id === order.user_id for customer orders and constant-time SHA-256 hash comparison of X-Guest-Token for guest orders, returning HTTP 403 ORDER_OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION on mismatch.

seeded_findings.title: Unvalidated callback_url Open Redirect
seeded_findings.seeded_behavior: Embeds unvalidated client callback_url directly into the AcmePay checkout redirect target, permitting off-domain phishing or javascript: URIs.
seeded_findings.patched_behavior: Validates callback_url strictly for https:// scheme, absence of userinfo/backslash tricks, and exact hostname match against config allowed_callback_hosts, returning HTTP 422 INVALID_CALLBACK_URL otherwise.

seeded_findings.title: Missing Idempotency Key Expiration Cleanup
seeded_findings.owasp_api_2023: API4:2023 Unrestricted Resource Consumption / Stale State Replay
seeded_findings.seeded_behavior: Reads checkout_idempotency_keys without purging expired expires_at rows, replaying stale expired checkout responses and allowing unbounded table growth.
seeded_findings.patched_behavior: Purges expired checkout_idempotency_keys rows (expires_at <= now) prior to lookup, enforces SHA-256 request payload binding (HTTP 409 on mismatch), and sets deterministic expires_at TTL on newly cached responses.
